description: This file defines the EndpointProvider class, which provides static methods for resolving and creating endpoint provider functions within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods to resolve endpoints, get the default provider, and create pattern-based providers.

classes.name: EndpointProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for resolving endpoint providers, obtaining default providers, and creating pattern-based providers in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Invokes a provider function with given arguments and returns the resulting endpoint data array, throwing an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint provider function, using the PartitionEndpointProvider's defaultProvider method.

methods.name: patterns
methods.description: Creates a new PatternEndpointProvider instance with specified endpoint patterns.
